Anika: Starting mini-bake: rolling redwood/gpt-medium:v2.14.3 -> prod (eu-west) at 15% traffic. Change window 2026-03-21 17:00-18:00 UTC. Observability: p90 latency, 5xx rate, kvcache OOM alarms, embedding-quality on eval set. @Ravi oncall please standby. roll_id=rb-20260321-15pct

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollout initiated · roll_id=rb-20260321-15pct · target=15% · routes updated (/v1/generate -> variant=v2.14.3) · started_at=2026-03-21T17:03:02Z

Sam: Can we get explicit rollback criteria?

Anika: Rollback criteria (auto/manual):
- latency: p90 > baseline * 2 for 3 consecutive 5m windows
- errors: 5xx or 4xx spike causing error-rate increase > 0.5% absolute OR absolute > 1%
- embedding QC: average cosine similarity drop vs baseline > 0.03 on our eval prompts
- kvcache OOM or new OOMs in pods
- throughput < 60% expected for 10m
- any customer-facing regression reported by CS in first 30m
(we'll follow auto-fallback if critical, otherwise manual hold + rollback)

Priya: Model quant & pin confirmed? fallback path?

Anika: Yes pin = redwood/gpt-medium:v2.14.3-quant. Fallback: automatic fallback to redwood/gpt-medium:v2.14.2 on critical alarms; manual rollback steps below.

Anika: ````
# rollback to previous stable
rdeploy rollback --id rb-20260321-15pct --to-version redwood/gpt-medium:v2.14.2
rdeploy finalize --drain 60s
````

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: healthhooks active · metrics cadence=5m · watching: latency,error-rate,kvcache-oom,embedding-qc · will post summary every 5m

Ravi: Kvcache OOM alarm thresholds set (1/min). If we see any new OOMs I'll call hold and start triage.

Sam: Infra LGTM to proceed to 15% :thumbsup:

Priya: QA running smoke suite against canary. Will report immediately on failures.

Oncall Ops: Quick stop commands if needed: `deploy-bot stop rb-20260321-15pct` or manual rollback with `rdeploy rollback` (see snippet).

Anika: Okay starting bake in 2m. Please react with :thumbsup: to go, :stop_sign: to hold.

Sam: :+1:
Priya: :+1:
Ravi: :stop_sign: (see kvcache alarm rule, will escalate if we hit any OOMs)

[~7 minutes later]
deploy-bot: metrics-summary (5m) · p90=1.8x baseline · error-rate +0.2% (0.3% -> 0.5%) · embedding-delta=0.015 · 5xx=0.15% · no kvcache OOMs observed

Priya: QA smoke: 1/120 failures — sample prompt "order-summary" occasionally returns truncated response (appears rate-limited in canary). Capturing logs and diffs.

Sam: p90 at 1.8x is trending up but below auto threshold. errors +0.2% small but keep watching.

Ravi: I'm seeing increased 429s to the canary pods (rate-limit) and a couple of transient 503s. I want to hold and roll back to be safe.

Anika: Holding rollout now. Initiating rollback to v2.14.2 per plan. Executing: `rdeploy rollback --id rb-20260321-15pct --to-version redwood/gpt-medium:v2.14.2`

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollback started · roll_id=rb-20260321-15pct · target_version=redwood/gpt-medium:v2.14.2 · initiated_at=2026-03-21T17:12:41Z

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollback complete · roll_id=rb-20260321-15pct · status=success · traffic restored to v2.14.2 · finalized_at=2026-03-21T17:13:30Z

Anika: Thanks all. Moving to postmortem: create an issue with logs, QA repro, and KV cache config diff. We'll re-run a focused test with adjusted rate-limits and a smaller heat-up next window.

Priya: adding screenshots + failing prompt repro to the issue.

Ravi: I'll follow up on rate-limit thresholds and OOM guardrails.

Sam: Noted. Thanks for the quick reaction. :thumbsup:

Anika: Closing thread. Follow-up doc: /docs/releases/mini-bake-2026-03-21-postmortem (TBD)
